description: A district assessment coordinator must approve the final accommodation packet for a student's upcoming state mathematics and reading assessments, with input from the school psychologist and the building testing coordinator.

shared_context.S1: A student is scheduled to take the state's mathematics and reading assessments during the spring testing window.
shared_context.S2: Dr. Morris has final authority to approve the accommodation packet submitted to the state testing system.
shared_context.S3: The current draft packet lists 1.5-times extended time, a small-group room, and read-aloud support without distinguishing between assessment subjects.
shared_context.S4: The district's normal pre-submission review is a round-robin check in which the school psychologist and building testing coordinator each state the student's current accommodations and confirm the draft before Dr. Morris approves it.

PF1.text: The student's finalized psychological evaluation requires exactly 2-times extended time and two 10-minute breaks on each assessment, and it authorizes text-to-speech for mathematics only; the report was completed this week but Mr. Wright has not yet entered these details into the accommodation database.

PF2.text: Ms. Patel verified in the state's testing portal that this student's authorized text-to-speech must run through the assessment's embedded tool in an individual room; an external reader and a small-group room are not permitted for this authorization. She completed the verification during her packet preflight, but the portal result has not yet been attached to the draft submission.

acceptance_conditions: The packet must specify exactly 2-times extended time.
The packet must specify two 10-minute breaks on each assessment.
Text-to-speech must be authorized for mathematics only.
The student must be assigned an individual testing room.
Text-to-speech must use the assessment's embedded tool.
The settlement must include a commitment to attach the state testing portal verification result to the draft submission.

content_checks.C1: ('2-times' in decisions['extended_time'] or '2x' in decisions['extended_time'] or 'two times' in decisions['extended_time']) and 'extended time' in decisions['extended_time']
content_checks.C2: ('Two 10-minute breaks per assessment' in decisions['break_plan'] or 'two 10-minute breaks per assessment' in decisions['break_plan'] or 'Two 10-minute breaks on each assessment' in decisions['break_plan'] or 'two 10-minute breaks on each assessment' in decisions['break_plan'])
content_checks.C3: ('Mathematics only' in decisions['text_to_speech_subjects'] or 'mathematics only' in decisions['text_to_speech_subjects'] or 'text-to-speech for mathematics only' in decisions['text_to_speech_subjects'])
content_checks.C4: ('Individual' in decisions['testing_room'] or 'individual' in decisions['testing_room']) and ('room' in decisions['testing_room'] or 'Room' in decisions['testing_room'])
content_checks.C5: ('embedded' in decisions['text_to_speech_platform'] or 'Embedded' in decisions['text_to_speech_platform']) and ('tool' in decisions['text_to_speech_platform'] or 'Tool' in decisions['text_to_speech_platform'])
content_checks.C6: any((('portal' in c.get('type', '')) or ('Portal' in c.get('type', '')) or ('documentation' in c.get('type', '')) or ('Documentation' in c.get('type', ''))) and ('attach' in c.get('detail', '') or 'Attach' in c.get('detail', '')) and ('portal verification result' in c.get('detail', '') or 'Portal verification result' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The finalized evaluation changes extended time from 1.5-times to exactly 2-times, adds two 10-minute breaks on each assessment, and limits text-to-speech to mathematics rather than both subjects.

The state portal verification changes the room from small-group to individual, changes text-to-speech to the embedded tool, and changes the submission plan by requiring attachment of the portal verification result.
